messages:
maria: quick follow-up from the postmortem — multi-region paging storm on Tue. I sketched a short remediation plan + owners. please ack and add if missing.

jonathan: ack. can we split this into short (<=1w) vs long (>1w) workstreams? also, want to know if we keep paging for threshold X.

maria: yes. Short: alert dedupe, reduce noisy thresholds, update paging policy. Long: capacity autoscale tuning, KV cache improvements. I'll propose owners below.

kevin: +1. For dedupe suggestion: group alerts by `service,route` and add a 10m dedupe window. Example Prom rule snippet: 
```
alert: HighRequestErrors
expr: increase(requests_errors_total[5m]) > 50
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: p2
  page: 'true'
annotations:
  dedupe_by: '{{service}}/{{route}}'
```
Also recommend change: only page if `incident_impact >= 0.2` (custom metric).

jonathan: agree on dedupe_by. timeline suggestion: short items done by EOD Fri (owners: kevin, sara), long items 3w (owners: maria + infra).

maria: assigning: kevin -> implement dedupe rules and new Prom snippet (due 2028-03-29), sara -> threshold audit and reduce noisy alerts (due 2028-03-29), maria -> update paging rotation & runbook (due 2028-04-05). QA: jonathan to verify observability metrics.

diana-bot: Incident bot: summary attached — 8 paged incidents, noise ratio 0.72, top root cause 'retry loop' in worker-v2. Link: https://incidents/reports/1842001111

kevin: noted the retry-loop pattern — I can add a metric `worker_retry_rate` and alert at 10% before paging. That should cut noise. Will PR today.

jonathan: also propose adding a weekly recurring job to sweep/close stale firing alerts older than 24h so we don't keep paging on stuck states.

maria: great. I'll create a tracking ticket and add owners+due dates. Action items in thread: 
- A1 kevin: add `dedupe_by` + 10m window to request error alerts, include `incident_impact` gating, PR link in thread (due 2028-03-29)
- A2 sara: run threshold audit across all services, propose new thresholds and mute plan (due 2028-03-29)
- A3 maria: update paging rotation doc, add escalation matrix, link to runbook (due 2028-04-05)
- A4 jonathan: add observability checks and weekly stale-alert sweep job (due 2028-04-05)

kevin: I'll update the runbook with a snippet for paging escalation matrix and post the PR here. :eyes: (reacted with :thumbsup: by maria)

maria: closing loop — please add short PR links in this thread when done. :white_check_mark:
